expanded_phrases.perfect: No visible dead ends in the scoped helper/role-preview workflow: every visible action works, is preview-only, or is disabled with a clear reason.
expanded_phrases.working: Role-preview and helper actions must execute their intended safe behavior, preserve read-only boundaries, and give visible feedback without external writes.
expanded_phrases.crisp: Controls align on a consistent grid, spacing is deliberate, copy is short, and the first viewport avoids wasted empty bands.
expanded_phrases.clean: No duplicate controls, debug-only clutter, role-inappropriate diagnostics, or unlabelled action clusters in normal user views.
expanded_phrases.organized: Primary, secondary, and diagnostic actions are visually grouped by user intent and preserve the selected workspace/project.
expanded_phrases.mobile: At 430px and 390px, controls wrap predictably, buttons remain tappable, no horizontal overflow appears, and helper/preview panels do not occlude route content.
expanded_phrases.desktop: At 1440px, 1024px, and 768px, toolbar/subcategory/filter/action rows align, avoid wasted space, and preserve readable density.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Helper and preview UX must use first-party BNA/One Time role-scoped patterns only; external provider writes remain out of scope.

requirements.statement: Verify and release the helper and One Time role-preview UI so scoped actions are aligned, organized, role-safe, and responsive on desktop and mobile.
requirements.expected_result: The current local worker fixes for tasks #2025 and #2026 are independently audited, any failures are fixed, and the deployed app proves the helper/role-preview workflow through desktop/mobile visual smoke and no-write role-safety checks.
acceptance_criteria: Operations Safe Role Preview controls have consistent button height, alignment, wrapping, and clear active/preview/read-only state.
Provider view-as route clearly shows read-only context, a return-to-Operations path, and blocked write controls.
Member/student preview routes use test or preview data and do not post live member/student actions.
No super-admin diagnostics or developer clutter appears in normal Rabbi/member/student preview surfaces.
Desktop and mobile screenshots prove no horizontal overflow, overlapping buttons, duplicated toolbar rows, or helper panel occlusion.
Action and route registries match every visible role-preview/helper action.
The deployed live smoke passes before task closeout.

criteria: Existing worker diffs for tasks #2025 and #2026 are present in the worktree.
Affected routes are limited to Operations, provider review/view-as, and member preview route for this packet.
No external provider write or account mutation is required.
Current-state screenshot evidence is still required before final product/UI Done.
